messages:
nina.pm: Sync: Sycamore-XL community checkpoint asked to be listed on CloudLane marketplace + three SI bundles. Legal wants distro + derivative-binary rules before we hand over kernels. Quick alignment?

oliver.legal: High level: allow non-exclusive hosting + managed offers. Deny standalone resale of raw weights. Derivative binaries (optimized kernels) require a limited derivative license: attribution, no relicensing, and audit rights for 90 days.

diego.eng: From eng: we'll provide signed artifacts with a manifest and checksum. Proposed tag: `redwood-sycamore-v0.9+quant-q4_v2+buildf6a1`. Recommend ed25519-signed manifest inside tar.

hana.hw: HW partners (EdgeBoxMini & RackX) need two kernel builds (cuda & avx512). Also ask: can we include vendor-optimized libs? If so, need explicit permission on derivative binaries.

maya.sales: Sales note: partners ask for short GTM placement windows (14-21 days). We can offer featured placement but not distribution exclusivity. Need template language for marketplace listing.

oliver.legal: I'll draft: "Sycamore-XL via Redwood Inference is available under a non-exclusive redistribution license. Partners must preserve attribution and may not resell raw weights. Contact partnerships@redwood.ai for commercial placement terms."

diego.eng: We'll produce `kernel-edgeboxmini.tar.gz` and `kernel-rackx.tar.gz` and a `compat.json` with supported backends. Example (short): `{"artifact_tag":"redwood-sycamore-v0.9+quant-q4_v2+buildf6a1","supported_backends":["cuda11.8","avx512-q4_v2"],"sha256":"..."}`

build-bot: Uploaded manifest-spec-v2 and sample kernels to /internal/partner-assets/sycamore/.

nina.pm: Actions: Oliver draft distro + derivative license + marketplace blurb (Wed COB); Diego produce kernels + manifest (Tue); Hana confirm hardware blockers (Tue); Maya collect GTM placement requests (Fri). We'll treat this thread as canonical for onboarding.

maya.sales: Got it, will ping top partners.

oliver.legal: Note: verify upstream contributor addendum for Sycamore. If missing, require it signed before any redistribution.

nina.pm: Thanks everyone. Marking thread as reference :white_check_mark:
